## 2.10 pytest-cov, in the group test {#step-02.10}

The tests pass, but we do not know which lines of the code they run. [pytest-cov](https://pytest-cov.readthedocs.io/) measures that, when pytest gets the
option `--cov`. It goes in the group `test`.

pytest-cov is a plugin of pytest. It runs the tests under coverage.py, which
records each line that runs, and it prints the report at the end.

This change came from running `uv add --group test pytest-cov`.

In `pyproject.toml`, the group `test` has `"pytest-cov>=7.1.0",` between pytest and pytest-mock. `uv.lock` has
pytest-cov 7.1.0, and coverage 7.16.2, which it needs.

```bash
just test --cov=wikiapp
```

Under the tests, a table lists each file of `src/wikiapp`, with its statements and the share of them that ran.
`console.py` has 18 statements. One of them did not run, so its line reads `94%`. The total is `95%`.

### What changed {#step-02.10-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-02.10-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: pytest-cov in the group `test`. 1 line added. It comes from `uv add --group test pytest-cov`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp/blob/8409e0f2e7f68a697de1e8bf32a745658364f17f/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `"pytest-cov>=7.1.0",`
- <a id="step-02.10-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: pytest-cov, and coverage, the package that it needs. 100 lines added. It comes from `uv add --group test pytest-cov`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp/blob/8409e0f2e7f68a697de1e8bf32a745658364f17f/uv.lock){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

## 2.11 Coverage on every run {#step-02.11}

A person can forget to type `--cov=wikiapp`. The settings of pytest in `pyproject.toml` give it options for
every run. They tell pytest to look for tests in `tests`, to measure coverage, and to list the lines that no test
ran.

[± See the change to `pyproject.toml`](#step-02.11-pyproject.toml-5d07e7-diff){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

At the end of `pyproject.toml`, the new table `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` has `testpaths = ["tests"]`. Its line
`addopts` gives pytest the options `--cov=wikiapp --cov-report=term-missing` for every run.

The tests of the original wikiapp had one more fixture, `mock_wikipedia_random_page`, and a test that was commented
out. No test used them, so the project does not keep them.

```bash
just test
```

The table under the tests now has a column `Missing`. `console.py` reads `94%`, and its missing line is 22. Line 22
is the call to `main` at the end, which runs only when you run the file as a script.

### What changed {#step-02.11-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-02.11-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: the settings of pytest. They name the folder of the tests, and turn coverage on for every run. 5 lines added. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp/blob/7508f1d424d5f906ee4630be09b2fddf3483e9c4/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `addopts = "--cov=wikiapp --cov-report=term-missing"`

<a id="step-02.11-pyproject.toml-5d07e7-diff"></a>

<details><summary>The diff of <code>pyproject.toml</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -29,3 +29,8 @@ test = [
     "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
     "pytest-mock>=3.16.0",
 ]
+
+[tool.pytest.ini_options]
+testpaths = ["tests"]
+# Every run measures how much of src/wikiapp the tests run, and lists the lines they do not
+addopts = "--cov=wikiapp --cov-report=term-missing"
```

</details>

[This change on GitHub](https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp/commit/7508f1d424d5f906ee4630be09b2fddf3483e9c4){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
